answer: In-person notary attestation binds each account to a signed visit: a licensed notary checks a government ID, records a fee of about 15 dollars, and signs a key that the ledger accepts once per document. Even at its nadir that cost is a trip, a fee and a real ID per head, and reused documents ripple into revocation of every linked key, so a fleet cannot keep an ember of a fake going cheaply.
